snippet.title: Jollibae Horror Game (2024) | Release Trailer
snippet.description:
The game is free to download and play here:
🎮 https://lex-lex.itch.io/jollibae-2024
🎮 https://gamejolt.com/games/Jollibae-2024/892650

📝 SYNOPSIS

                   A well-known professional eater signed up to participate in an annual eating competition sponsored by the well-known fast-food chain Jollibae with the promise of an incredible prize, but after learning about the branch's history, things are not what they seem.

💡 GAME INFO

                    Jollibae is a horror parody game of a popular fast food restaurant Jollibee. In this game, the player assumes control of a professional eater taking part in a challenge that Jollibae has set up. In addition to learning about the history of the locations, the player must eat and work through easy puzzles to win a mystery prize.

⚙️ FEATURES

- 10 - 15 minutes of playtime 
- Modern and Retro aesthetics
- Chasing sequences
- Jump scares
- Casual Difficulty
- Story and Lore, a combination of horror, comedy, and absurdity


NOTE: We do not own any of the music used in the game and the trailer.

Music used:

Artist: Karl Casey @ White Bat Audio

Eternal Night
